# HelioPay Security Questionnaire

## Data Handling

HelioPay processes employee names, mailing addresses, and bank-account tokens
for payroll card disbursement.
HelioPay does not receive employee Social Security numbers through this service.

## Security Controls

SOC 2 Type II report date: 2025-11-30
Data encrypted at rest and in transit.
Single sign-on is supported for admin users.

## Security Exceptions

HelioPay does not support customer-managed encryption keys for this service.
